name: Ajani Steadfast
oracle_text:
+1: Until end of turn, up to one target creature gets +1/+1 and gains first strike, vigilance, and lifelink.
−2: Put a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control and a loyalty counter on each other planeswalker you control.
−7: You get an emblem with "If a source would deal damage to you or a planeswalker you control, prevent all but 1 of that damage."
blocked_sentences: −7: You get an emblem with "If a source would deal damage to you or a planeswalker you control, prevent all but 1 of that damage."

needs.what: a static damage-prevention effect that caps each source's damage event at N ("prevent all but 1 of that damage"), applying to a player (affects_player: you) as well as to permanents matching a filter (planeswalkers you control), usable on an emblem
needs.why_existing_wont_do: The `prevent_damage` static is either absorb-N (prevents N, lets the rest through) or `prevent_all` (prevents everything), and is read only by `damage_permanent` so it never protects a player; 'all but 1' is the inverse of absorb-N (lets 1 through, prevents the rest). `replace_damage` is a multiplier refused below 2, and `damage_life_floor` is a life-total floor op, not a per-source cap.
